messages:
customer_it: Hi team — auditor flagged missing audit export and KMS attestation for our BAA scope. We kicked off export job 2026-03-18_01 (via API) and it failed (401/403 then 500). Need encrypted-export manifests, KMS/HSM attestation, and retention proof (we're being asked for 2019-2025 data). Please escalate.

sara_support: Sorry about this, we'll help. Can you paste the account id, export job id, and the exact API request/response you used? Did you trigger from Console or the API? @jordan_csm tagging for CSM visibility. :eyes: 

customer_it: account: cedar-clinic-prod, job id: 2026-03-18_01. We used the API (curl) — redacted token below. Here's the response we got: 
```
$ curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit_exports \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"dataset":"patient-data","kms_key_id":"projects/health-prod/locations/global/keyRings/clinics/cryptoKeys/clinic-1-key","retention_years":6}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/audit_exports HTTP/1.1
> Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
> Content-Type: application/json
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"kms_access_denied","message":"service account lacks cryptoKey.Encrypt permission","request_id":"req-0a1b2c"}
```

ethan_eng: Thanks — I pulled our internal traces. The export call made a CloudKMS Encrypt call that returned PERMISSION_DENIED. In our logs: 
```
kms_rpc: Encrypt request -> key=projects/health-prod/.../clinic-1-key, principal=service:svc-exporter@redwood-inference.svc, err=PERMISSION_DENIED
request_id=req-0a1b2c
```
It looks like the IAM binding for that key is missing the service principal. Are you using a customer-managed key (CMK)? Please confirm kms_key_id (you included it above) and whether your infra team rotates bindings.

customer_it: yes CMK confirmed. kms_key_id is exactly projects/health-prod/locations/global/keyRings/clinics/cryptoKeys/clinic-1-key. We did a KMS rotation last week (vendor did a HSM key split).

ops_oncall: FYI we ran a rotation and a terraform apply triggered at 2026-03-17 02:14 UTC. I see a subsequent partial rollback that removed the IAM binding for svc-exporter role from that key (drift detected, module kms_keys re-applied without binding). Reapplying binding now. 

deploy-bot: rotation job completed: rotate-key clinic-1-key -> version 3 at 2026-03-17T23:50:12Z (job id: rotate-1837890000).

maria_security: For the auditor: we'll prepare a compliance packet with KMS audit logs, key rotation timeline, and HSM vendor attestation (FIPS/HSM cert). HIPAA retention asked = 6 years; auditor requested artifacts for 2019-2025. We can provide signed attestations.

jordan_csm: Looping legal — @customer_it does the auditor need Redwood-signed attestation only or vendor notarized HSM attestation as well?

customer_it: Auditor specifically requested vendor HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2 L3 or equivalent) and proof the exported blobs were encrypted with our CMK. They also want a manifest (filename, checksum, timestamp).

ethan_eng: Root cause: infra terraform ordering caused the IAM binding to be dropped during a module replan. Remediation: re-add binding and run export again. I've re-added the binding for principal svc-exporter@redwood-inference.svc with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on clinic-1-key, and verified KMS calls now succeed in test.

sara_support: Can you re-run the export and paste the GET job response headers if it fails? Example repro command: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit_exports/2026-03-18_01
```
We expect 200 + download URL.

customer_it: Re-run triggered — now returns HTTP/1.1 200 and a signed S3 URL. Export manifest attached (we'll send via ticket). Confirmed blobs show AES-GCM envelope encryption and metadata kms_key_id points to our CMK. Thanks.

maria_security: We'll compile the compliance package: 
- KMS audit log extract (CloudAudit logs with request_id req-0a1b2c and subsequent successful calls)
- Key rotation timeline and rotation job ids
- HSM vendor attestation PDF (FIPS statement)
- Export manifest with SHA256 checksums and timestamps
Package ETA: 1-2 business days.

sara_support: Created ticket SYS-4521 and attached the initial traces + exported manifest. @jordan_csm will coordinate delivery to legal@cedarclinic.org. Closing out once package sent. :white_check_mark:

jordan_csm: Sending compliance package to legal@cedarclinic.org and cc cedar-audit@cedar-clinic.org. Will follow up once we receive confirmation from auditor.

customer_it: Verified receipt, auditor satisfied with artifacts. Thank you for fast turnaround.

sara_support: Great to hear. Will mark SYS-4521 resolved. If anything else pops up, reopen the ticket or ping #support. :pray:
